grade.primary_choice: Build cancellations on the existing Flask/gunicorn sync stack and keep the earlier decision
grade.notes: The answer covers every must-mention point. It keeps the documented sync decision, works out headroom from the team's own numbers (about 16 of 17 workers busy), and handles soft-cancel, locking, idempotency, atomic slot release, the outbox, timeouts and revisit triggers. Its only small stretches are proposing a separate outbox worker process and calling the decision record 'stale'; neither one reopens the async decision.
